title: Develop characters, world, or research

stage.name: Characters
stage.description: The people and the world of the story come to life.

questions.prompt: What makes a character feel real?
options: Clear wants, fears and a history that shapes them
questions.why: Readers connect with characters whose choices make sense because of who they are.

questions.prompt: Match each word to its meaning.
pairs: What happened before the story begins
What a character wants, and why
Where and when the story happens
questions.why: Backstory and motivation explain choices. Setting gives them a place.

questions.prompt: Nonfiction writers research to make sure their facts are accurate.
questions.why: Readers trust a book that gets its facts right.

questions.prompt: How can two people understand each other's backstories better?
options: Ask about families, traditions and past experiences with curiosity
Assume your backgrounds are the same
questions.why: Curiosity says “I want to know you.” Judgment closes the door.

talk: What's a family tradition that shaped who you are?
